Name: Face display
Subsystem: The OLED display path: the 128x64 packing and the display message
Purpose: The robot reports nothing about its own screen, so the packing is only ever confirmed by looking at it. A face that is mirrored, offset or half drawn is invisible to every automated check there is.
ExpectedTelemetry: the display messages are sent and acknowledged by the transport
ExpectedPhysical: A pair of eyes is drawn squarely on the screen, right way up, held steady for the whole time, and it clears afterwards.
